kind: # The seasons and cycles of each book.  The prayer books themselves prescribe
# no colors; these are the customary Western ones (purple Advent, Pre-Lent and
# Lent, red Holy Week and Whitsuntide, white and green otherwise), and Common
# The Anglican Church in North America, 2019.
# Common Worship: the Epiphany season is white until the Presentation, and
# Ordinary Time (green) runs from then until Lent, if there is any.
# The Church in Wales: from 2011 the colors its bishops agreed in June 2011 (Lectionary, "Colours":
# white Christmas Day to Candlemas, green 3 February to Shrove Tuesday, Passion red or purple in Holy Week,
# red Pentecost Sunday, green from the Monday after it, red an option for the Kingdom season); before
# 2011 the prayer book's year below.  The first match wins.
